{{Top|leg}}
'''Thanus March''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] freelance [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:AHoCITaK">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||A Hutt on Corellia -- Isn't That a Kick}} on Corellia</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], March spent most of his time traveling [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and did not often come back to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:MFIGaWP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||My Friend, I've Got a Wildlife Problem}} on Corellia</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Thanus March returned to Corellia after a long stay on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:MFIGaWP" /> However, upon arriving on Corellia, March discovered that a band of [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt gangsters]] were messing around near his home and harassing his friends. The spacer thus decided to eliminate the Hutt boss and recruited a group of freelance enforcers to deal with the cronies.<ref name="SWG:AHoCITaK" /> Around the same time, Thanus March also hired a bunch of spacers to deal with wild creatures that had overrun his family's land as he had to leave Corellia again to deliver freight due on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:MFIGaWP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thanus March was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AHoCITaK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Thanus March was mentioned in two mission, called "A Hutt on Corellia -- Isn't That a Kick" and "My Friend, I've Got a Wildlife Problem" available on [[mission terminal]]s on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:AHoCITaK" /><ref name="SWG:MFIGaWP" />
